_help: Which leagues and seasons scrape.py fetches. Set 'scrape' to true for a league and run: python scrape.py
seasons: shown in the dashboard and used by the value model. history: only used for the model's last-season features.
id: the number in the league's FotMob URL, e.g. fotmob.com/leagues/40/... is 40.
transfermarkt: the league's competition code in transfermarkt-datasets, used by transfermarkt.py to confirm player matches.
dashboard_league: the league build_data.py and value_model.py use (the dashboard shows one league for now).
